format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

probes.title: an image named by the label and what the data does; no Tab stop
probes.covers: accessibility (role img, name label), settings.items, settings.summary, settings.y-format

steps.check: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#s [role=img]'); return s && s.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Посещения: от 340 до 488, наибольшее 488, наименьшее 340' && !document.querySelector('#s [tabindex]') && document.querySelectorAll('#s .sf-chart-sparkline-line').length === 1 && document.querySelectorAll('#s .sf-chart-sparkline-mark').length === 1; })()

probes.title: bar draws one bar per value, a gap draws none and a zero a hairline; extremes marks the highest and the lowest

steps.check: (() => { const bars = document.querySelectorAll('#b .sf-chart-sparkline-bar'); return bars.length === 4 && document.querySelectorAll('#b .sf-chart-sparkline-bar--mark').length === 2 && [...bars].every((bar) => Number(bar.getAttribute('height')) >= 1); })()

probes.title: empty says no data with a dotted baseline; loading holds the box and is busy

steps.check: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('#e [role=img]'); const l = document.querySelector('#l [role=img]'); return e.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Пусто: нет данных' && document.querySelector('#e .sf-chart-sparkline-empty') && l.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true' && l.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; })()

probes.title: summary none names the image by its label alone
